title: Structure of Clifford groups of composite finite quantum systems
summary: In this paper the Clifford groups of general multipartite quantum systems with configuration space $\mathbb{Z}_{n_1}\oplus\cdots\oplus\mathbb{Z}_{n_k}$, $k\geq 1$ are studied. It is known that the Clifford group is a natural semidirect product provided the dimension $N=n_1\cdots n_k$ of the corresponding Hilbert space is an odd number. For even $N$ special results on the Clifford groups are scattered in the mathematical literature, but they do not concern the semidirect product structure.
